detail.overview: Embark on a journey into limitless entertainment with the Intex 43-inch Full HD Smart Android 9.0 LED TV. From 1.07 billion vivid colors to powerful 20W Box Speakers, every detail is designed for unparalleled enjoyment. With Android 9.0 OS, certified apps like Netflix and Disney+ Hotstar, and seamless connectivity and unlimited streaming are at your fingertips. Elevate your entertainment with our sleek TV that's not just a screen but a gateway to an extraordinary viewing experience.
features: Edge-to-edge brilliance with 43" FHD Smart TV
20W Box Speakers for immersive sound experience
Certified Apps: Netflix, Disney+ Hotstar, and Prime Video for unlimited entertainment
Wide 178° viewing angle for cinematic experience
HDMI ARC Connectivity for seamless integration
